prompt: One bedroom has floor area $x^2 + 6x$ square feet, and a second bedroom has $2x^2 + 3x$ square feet. Write the total floor area of both bedrooms.
hint: Total means ADD the two areas: $(x^2 + 6x) + (2x^2 + 3x)$.

hints.text: Total means ADD the two areas: $(x^2 + 6x) + (2x^2 + 3x)$.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Practice combining first: $x^2 + 2x^2 = 3x^2$. Only match x-squared with x-squared, and plain x with plain x.

alternativeExplanations.title: Two kinds of tiles
steps: Think of x²-tiles (big squares) and x-tiles (long strips) covering each floor.
Room one uses 1 big square and 6 strips; room two uses 2 big squares and 3 strips.

alternativeExplanations.title: Check with x = 10
steps: Room one: 100 + 60 = 160 sq ft. Room two: 200 + 30 = 230 sq ft. Total: 390.
